Ecclesiasticalot FF: They are used for my maintenance, but since usually they just lay around, how about bringing some of your bot parts here? Shanice and I could check on them and repair if needed.

You: Really? Are you going to use the Church's infrastructure for your own gain?

Shanice: Huh?! Don’t be a cheapskate!
